description: Fork of exp303 (current SOTA 1.6509 @ 8K). Single trade: out_tph_per_layer uniform 1024 across all layers. [2048,2048,1024,1024,1024,1024] -> [1024,1024,1024,1024,1024,1024]. -16.8 M params (~585 M total). Tests whether the layers 0-1 out_proj boost (2x tph) is actually needed. Completes the out_proj shape sweep: exp303 (heavy-early), exp304 (heavy-early + taper-late, worse), exp305 (uniform-2048, worse), exp306 (uniform-1024). If exp306 matches or beats exp303, the heavy-early scheme is unnecessary; if it loses, the scheme is justified.
